newsitem.title: USA: Councilman Maddox elected mayor of Tallahassee, Fla.
newsitem.headline: Councilman Maddox elected mayor of Tallahassee, Fla.

text.p: City Councilman Scott Maddox was elected mayor of Tallahassee, Fla., becoming the first to win the post since the city changed its charter to directly elected mayors.
Maddox won 51 percent of the vote in Tuesday's run-off election, defeating Florida State University professer Charles Billings by about 600 votes, Leon County elections officials said.
For the last 78 years, the city's five elected commissioners have held the post on a rotating basis, serving one-year terms.
In November, voters changed the county charter to directly elect their mayor. The change does not give the mayor any more power than a council member.
